assertions: at least one nonempty uniquely named and uniquely rooted filesystem budget is required
most-specific safe roots explicitly associate SQLite state including sibling sidecars, SQLite temp, transaction spool, and archive paths
relative dot roots cannot cover absolute configured paths and unrelated budgets are rejected
each associated role has a nonzero emergency, SQLite/WAL/temp, spool, backfill, or archive reservation as applicable
one shared filesystem validates the combined reservation while four nested/separate filesystem budgets validate independently
shared filesystem declarations must agree and empty, zero, uncovered, unassociated, mismatched, overflow, and overcommit inputs return stable exact codes
archive and backfill compatibility fingerprints include only their associated budget while runtime fingerprints the complete configuration
validation remains side-effect-free and does not perform or re-own runtime capacity/filesystem probes
